title: MeterMasterData
description: Reference data for a smart electricity meter from the utility's master database. Looked up at runtime via LookupRecord (DatabaseRecordLookup) using meterId as key. Mirrors the role of StationMasterData in the Luftqualität use case.

owner.description: Name of the metered party or building.

operator.description: Utility company or grid operator responsible for this meter.

frostThingId.description: FROST-Server @iot.id of the corresponding STA Thing (populated after initial FROST sync).

frostDatastreamIds.description: Maps quantity names to their FROST Datastream @iot.id.
